subject.title: fix(cli): reject unknown models in config set

question: Should `openclaw config set` reject changed text-model references at write time when runtime-equivalent catalog or auth-profile resolution cannot validate them, rather than preserving the existing deferred runtime failure behavior?
rationale: This is an intentional compatibility and operator-experience choice, not a mechanical defect: it changes when users discover provider/catalog or profile problems and may block otherwise valid configuration repair attempts during resolver unavailability.

options.title: Accept write-time fail-closed validation
options.body: Merge the PR with the new early error because immediate actionable feedback and unchanged config are preferable to deferred agent-run failures.

options.title: Keep deferred validation behavior
options.body: Pause this PR and retain current write behavior until maintainers choose a narrower compatibility-preserving policy for catalog or auth-resolution failures.

recommendation.title: Accept write-time fail-closed validation
recommendation.body: Merge the PR with the new early error because immediate actionable feedback and unchanged config are preferable to deferred agent-run failures.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent member review context specifically identifies this unresolved compatibility choice.
